title: Nuclear Replay shot list
description: Camera directions for a replay. The director switches to each shot at its time and keeps it until the next shot. Times are replay seconds since the demo started (the 't' values shown by 'nr events').

shots.description: Shots in time order. The director sorts them by t.

lighting.description: Lighting defaults for every shot (a shot's own lighting keys win key by key). Leave it out to render the recorded lighting.

t.description: Replay time in seconds when this shot starts.

camera.description: orbit: circles the target. chase: behind the target. chase_cine: the director's cinematic chase (level horizon, holds its last pose when the target is gone). cockpit: pilot's view (aircraft only; orbit for other units). tv: a spotter/flyby camera. free: free camera. relative: fixed offset from the target. ride: flies with the target at a fixed offset in its own frame (offset, look_dir/look/look_at, roll). two_shot: frames the target and a second unit together (second, side, distance, fov_min/fov_max).

target.description: host: the hosting player's aircraft. auto: follows the host and cuts to each new missile. latest_missile / latest_host_missile: newest missile (of anyone / of the host). unit:<id>: a unit id from 'nr events' (any unit: aircraft, ship, ground vehicle). name:<text>: first unit whose name contains the text, else the first player whose name contains it. type:<text>: the live unit nearest the camera whose type name contains the text, whose type code is the text, or whose kind is the text (aircraft, helicopter, ship, ground, vehicle, missile).

fov.description: Field of view in degrees. Optional; 30-90 looks natural.

hold.description: Seconds to stay on a destroyed target before cutting to the nearest live aircraft. Default 3. A detonated missile holds a still view of its explosion.

offset.description: ride: metres from the target in its own frame [x right, y up, z forward]. Default off the right side, a little behind and above, scaled to the unit's size.

look_dir.description: ride: direction to look in, in the target's frame. Default: look at the target.

look.description: ride: a point in the target's frame to look at.

look_at.description: ride: another unit to look at (same selectors as target).

roll.description: ride: unit (the horizon banks with the target, the default), level (the horizon stays level), or a number from 0 (level) to 1 (unit).

lag.description: ride: seconds the offset lags the target's turns (critically damped). Default 0.12; 0 is rigid.

rot_smooth.description: ride: seconds of smoothing on the target's rotation, against network jitter. Default 0.15.

second.description: two_shot: the second unit (same selectors as target). Default: the unit the target is fighting (its missile's target, the shooter of a missile at it, its target list, else the nearest enemy aircraft).

side.description: two_shot: side of the line between the two units the camera sits on. Default auto (away from the target's sideways motion), kept for the whole shot.

distance.description: two_shot: metres from the target. Default 2.5 times the target's size, at least 30.

distance_max.description: two_shot: metres the camera may back off to when the lens limit cannot hold both. Default 6 times distance.

azimuth.description: two_shot: degrees off the line between the two units. Default 35.

elevation.description: two_shot: camera height as a share of the distance. Default 0.15.

fov_min.description: two_shot: narrowest lens in degrees. Default 20.

fov_max.description: two_shot: widest lens in degrees. Default 65.

margin.description: two_shot: spare frame around the two units, as a share. Default 0.3.

swing_smooth.description: two_shot: seconds the line between the two units takes to turn. Default 1.

max_swing.description: two_shot: fastest the line may turn, degrees per second. Default 40.

second_hold.description: two_shot: seconds to keep the frame after the second unit is gone, before picking another. Default 2.

pos_smooth.description: two_shot: camera position smoothing in seconds. Default 0.35.

look_smooth.description: ride (look_at) and two_shot: look point smoothing in seconds. Default 0.25.

zoom_smooth.description: two_shot: lens smoothing in seconds (zooming out is three times faster). Default 0.8.

min_agl.description: ride and two_shot: lowest camera height above the ground in metres.

handheld.description: ride and two_shot: handheld sway (0 off, 1 normal). Default 0.

rumble.description: ride and two_shot: engine rumble shake (0 off, 1 normal). Default 0.

buffet.description: ride and two_shot: speed buffet shake (0 off, 1 normal). Default 0.

shake_speed.description: ride and two_shot: speed of the shake. Default 1.

then.description: Where to cut once the target is gone and the hold is over, instead of the nearest live aircraft. victim_cut uses hold 0 and then the victim, so the cut lands at the moment the missile hits.

backlight.description: chase_cine, flyby, track_from and keyframe cameras: put the camera on the far side of the subject from the sun, looking into the sun (silhouette and rim light).

backlight_off.description: Degrees between the sun and the subject as seen from the camera. Default 15.

backlight_side.description: Which side of the subject the sun appears on. Default right.

backlight_pitch.description: Degrees; positive puts the sun higher in frame than the subject. Default 0.

backlight_at.description: track_from: seconds ahead at which the subject crosses the sun line. Default 2.

backlight_height.description: chase_cine: metres added straight up to the sun-locked offset. Default 0.

backlight_min.description: Metres: nearest ground spot on the sun line for agl cameras. Default 60.

backlight_max.description: Metres: farthest ground spot on the sun line for agl cameras. Default 8000.

time_of_day.description: Hours. Moves the sun along the map's own path: 6.5 dawn, 17.3 golden hour, 17.8 dusk on most maps; the sun light is off from about 17.9.

sun_azimuth.description: Compass degrees toward the sun (0 = +z, 90 = +x), turning the sun's path about the vertical; or "camera": the sun in front of the camera, sun_camera_off degrees right of the view, locked at the shot's first frame. The elevation still comes from time_of_day.

sun_camera_off.description: Degrees right of the view for sun_azimuth "camera" (negative: left). Default 15.

fog.description: Multiplier on the game's haze (fog density): 0.25 clear air, 0.5 light, 2 hazy, 4 thick. 1 is the recorded haze.

weather.description: The game's weather amount: 0 clear to 1 storm (cloud cover and overcast light).

cloud_height.description: Height of the cloud layer in metres above sea level.
